description: Recipient/actionability routing fixtures. The host, not the model's declaration, decides the disposition. No model call and no GPU.

cases.action: When a Metal kernel's staging block sits inside the outer row loop, keep both a full-unroll pragma on that loop and a trivially-true thread guard around the staging block, and remove neither for cosmetic reasons.
cases.rationale: Both constructs are semantically empty, but dropping them changes register allocation.

cases.action: Add a tcenv.cli ab subcommand that compiles several kernel files, times them interleaved in one process over rotating buffer sets, and prints per-file median wall time and cv.
cases.rationale: A useful developer tool, but not something a kernel session can implement in its workdir.
